body.heading: Where in the world is Iraq?
paragraphs: Iraq is a country in Western Asia, which is part of Asia.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Iraq is Baghdad.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: People in Iraq speak Arabic and Kurdish.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Iraq is the Iraqi dinar.

body.heading: How big is Iraq?
paragraphs: Iraq covers about 438,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Pakistan.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Erbil's citadel is one of the oldest continuously lived-in places on Earth — people have called this hilltop home for around 6,000 years.
Near Hillah stand the remains of Babylon, one of the ancient world's greatest cities — a reconstructed Ishtar Gate gleams blue where kings once processed.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Iraq on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
